design: Concurrent clients ask the product question mix over HTTP against a running API, one thread per client, each picking questions round-robin from the training split so no held-out question is touched. Latency is wall-clock per request including the HydraDB round trip. Errors are counted by the API's own error code, not by exception type. The second pass repeats the same load while a Mend round writes to the same graph, to show what a writer does to read latency.

measured_on.note: a hosted HydraDB; its image digest is whatever that service runs and is not readable from here

rows.label: reads while a mend round writes
